To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
INCENP and aurora-B are in a complex that functions in the assembly of a mitotic spindle and in the regulation of cytokinesis.

1) INCENP, a chromosomal passenger, binds to the mitotic spindle midzone in an Aurora-B-dependent manner, 2) INCENP is a substrate of Aurora-B, 3) INCENP binds to survivin, a chromosomal protein, 4) survivin is a substrate of aurora-B and, 5) survivin and aurora-B colocalize in mitotic cells.

the chromosomal passenger complex is a macromolecular structure composed of INCENP, aurora-B kinase and survivin, and that the complex is involved in chromosome condensation, chromosome segregation and cytokinesis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of mitosis and cytokinesis by the chromosomal passenger complex.
understanding the mechanisms by which chromosomes are segregated in mitosis and the role of the passengers in this process.
the regulation and function of the chromosomal passengers, with particular emphasis on their roles in chromosome segregation and cytokinesis.

the chromosomal passengers are proteins, which are involved in mitosis, and which move from centromere to the spindle mid zone.
the chromosomal passengers are proteins, which are transported from centromeres during mitosis to the spindle mid zone, where they play an important role in the completion of mitosis.
the chromosomal passenger complex has multiple functions in cell division.

we are interested in the molecular mechanisms of chromosome segregation and cytokinesis.
the passengers are not just along for the ride, but rather are essential to the mitotic journey.
the chromosomal passengers are essential for the completion of mitosis.
